title: Live Test Release: Permanent Support Border
author: Cold Winters Lead
summary: Testing real-time update polling and verification of permanent button borders.
changes: Added permanent thin gray border to Support Us button.
fullArticle: This is the live test entry! Saving this file will trigger the pink unread dot on your bell icon within 5 seconds without refreshing the page. Clicking the bell will clear the dot and mark this version as read in your local storage.

title: Specialized Support Button & Pure White Theme
author: Cold Winters Dev Team
summary: This update introduces layout refinements alongside live news polling.
changes: Standardized nav highlights to pure white.
Refined icon proportions and tooltip animations.
fullArticle: We overhauled the layout based on community feedback. Standard navigation tabs now feature high-contrast pure white highlights, and clicking any news item opens its full article modal view.

title: Changelog Drawer Launch
author: Cold Winters Lead
summary: Added a live side drawer that fetches release notes directly from JSON.
changes: Integrated live polling and local read tracking.
fullArticle: Our live news system allows instant site updates without requiring full platform reloads.
